title: Cube-depth perception consistency
slide_intent: Compare physical construction with the viewer’s resulting image so spatial continuity can be judged directly.
strategic_value: Consistent perceived room depth can help Channel 4 transitions feel connected when the underlying cubes change.
demonstration: An upper isometric camera-and-cube diagram changes cube sizes while a lower front view moves across blue, pink and green rooms.
practical_value: Judge the perceived depth in the lower view against the construction changes above.

content_islands.name: Construction view
content_islands.spec: Place the camera and three colored cubes in the upper panel.

content_islands.name: Viewer result
content_islands.spec: Show the synchronized front-facing room view below for comparison.

reference_purposes.Application: The two synchronized views demonstrate cube-depth perception consistency.

ingredient.name: Perceived cube depth
ingredient.application: Compare the viewer-facing result with the camera and cube arrangement while changing room dimensions.
ingredient.scope: The demonstration shows relationships but provides no numeric camera or cube-depth values.
